- empty dict returns immediately with no `params` binding
- the preprocessing loop moves exact `{True}` / `{False}` known conditions into `conditions_set` and excludes them from `condition_names`
- every remaining name stays in `condition_names` in input dict order, including unknown names and `{True, False}`

- if an unknown name is encountered in the inner loop, `KeyError` is caught and the generator returns after only that first `params` binding
- when `condition_names` is empty, `itertools.product(..., repeat=0)` yields one empty tuple, so `params` becomes `{}` once
